name: proctor
description: Hook-enforced development discipline for Claude Code. Skills teach methodology; hooks enforce compliance; store survives compaction.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Branch names protected from destructive git operations (commit, push, merge, rebase, reset)

testFreshnessMinutes.title: Test freshness (minutes)
testFreshnessMinutes.description: How many minutes before test evidence expires and the git gate blocks commits

watchdogTurnThreshold.title: Skill watchdog threshold
watchdogTurnThreshold.description: Number of consecutive turns without a skill invocation before the watchdog fires a reminder

fixRoundCap.title: Fix-round cap
fixRoundCap.description: Maximum fix-loop rounds in SDD before the hook forces adjudication instead of another dispatch
